title: hamiltonia inodora
intro: Hamiltonia inodora, commonly known as Yellow Chiraito, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region and parts of Asia. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hamiltonia inodora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief, wound healing, and skin protection. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
